summary: Example generated role layout for myos interfaces: library/ holds the modules and module_utils/network/myos holds argspec, config, facts and utils.
questions: What does the role layout from the resource module builder look like?

answer_card.title: Generated role layout
answer_card.answer_md:
```text
roles/my_role/
  library/
    myos_facts.py
    myos_interfaces.py
  module_utils/network/myos/
    argspec/{facts,interfaces}/
    config/interfaces/
    facts/facts.py, facts/interfaces/
    utils/utils.py
  README.md
```
